testCases: the OpenCode adapter emits a typed pre-submit rejection and does not call promptAsync while the previous turn is still stopping
one typed OpenCode stop-boundary rejection reloads the owned runtime and retries the same structured prompt and run-options objects once
the durable OpenCode session handle is reused across runtime replacement
a second typed rejection fails without a second reload
ambiguous HTTP, overload, text-matched, and other-provider errors never reload or retry
the original pending-run lock survives reload so start waiters continue and duplicate prompts remain rejected
interrupt and close during reload cancel the unsent prompt whether runtime reload succeeds or fails
the runtime-only admission object is forwarded unchanged through provider wrapping
OpenCode claims admission after awaited preparation and before promptAsync, command, or summarize submission
interrupt, close, and shutdown after reload but before admission cancel the unsent retry and settle the original pending run
reload failure never reaches retry admission or submits the prompt

commands: jq -e '.schemaVersion == 1 and (.patches | length == 1) and .patches[0].base.tag == "v0.2.5" and .patches[0].base.commit == "6fc491e6220fba6543bbbe4bf1b1f58cfe59228b" and .patches[0].candidate.commit == "6318bc457d9bd5264cb63821fb5d6b05ca706dea"' patches/local-patches.json

patches.upstreamCondition: Submit independently while a typed OpenCode pre-submit stop-boundary rejection can leave an owned runtime unusable without one bounded reload and retry.
patches.dropCondition: Remove when the latest stable release provides equivalent typed pre-submit OpenCode stop-boundary recovery with exactly one owned-runtime reload and retry, preserved prompt and run-options identity, durable session reuse, pending-run exclusion, and interrupt/close/shutdown safety through final provider admission without retrying ambiguous failures.
